description: Keyword + semantic search over persisted posts in the local library — full-text + pgvector cosine, no LinkedIn pull, free. Use this when the caller has a query string and wants ranked persisted-post results. Pass `scope` (a post_collections.id) to limit to a specific collection. For fresh LinkedIn keyword pulls, use `linkedin_post_search` instead (5 credits).

mode.description: Search mode: hybrid (keyword + semantic), keyword (FTS only), or semantic (embedding similarity only)

scope.description: Optional post_collections.id to restrict results to a collection

name: search_posts
title: Search Posts
